Settings.GeneralHint.zh: 调整语言、界面和日常操作方式。
Settings.GeneralHint.en: Choose your language, appearance and everyday controls.

Settings.CanvasHistoryHint.zh: 设置绘画范围与本地历史保留数量。
Settings.CanvasHistoryHint.en: Set the drawing area and how much local history to retain.

Settings.ShortcutsHint.zh: 点击输入框后按下组合键。
Settings.ShortcutsHint.en: Select a field and press a key combination.

Settings.PassThroughLauncherHint.zh: 单击或右键进入绘画，双击切换画布显隐。
Settings.PassThroughLauncherHint.en: Click or right-click to draw; double-click to show or hide the canvas.
